description: Extract structured fields from 1 to 5 Arabic documents in one paid call: $0.10 for the batch, i.e. $0.02 per document instead of $0.03. Documents are processed independently and in parallel, results come back in request order with an echoed id, and one unreadable image does not fail the rest (it appears with ok=false and an error). Use this for a stack of receipts, invoices or bank slips.

documents.description: 1 to 5 documents, extracted independently and in parallel.

id.description: Optional correlation id, echoed back as results[].id.

mime_type.description: Default MIME type for documents that omit their own.

name: doc_extract_batch
title: Extract document fields (batch)
